name: floodwise
display_name: floodwise — England flood risk by postcode
description: England flood-risk by postcode for AI agents — official Environment Agency open data, not guesses.
long_description: Look up the long-term flood-risk band (High / Medium / Low / Very Low) for an England postcode, straight from official Environment Agency open data (Open Government Licence) — or an honest "not found" outside England. All data is bundled, so it works fully offline with no key and no setup. Area-level and long-term (not property-level or live); not insurance or planning advice.

tools.name: flood_risk_by_postcode
tools.description: Get the long-term flood-risk band for an England postcode.
